{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pearl Island Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|gambling establishment]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pavo Prime/Legends|Pavo Prime]]. The casino was secretly operated by the [[Invisible Shell]], a group of [[Jenet/Legends|Jenets]] under the command of [[Ludlo Lebauer]] and his uncle, [[Lorimar Lebauer]].
